files.description: Club members, one per row (240 rows): member_id (whole number), full_name (first and last name; many names have accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent), home_city (city name, several with accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent; about 3% of cells are empty and about 3% hold "-" for an unknown city), fee (yearly fee, two decimals).

task_text: Give every distinct home city a number: tidy the names first (remove surrounding spaces, capitalise each word), then number the cities 0, 1, 2, ... in alphabetical order. Members whose city is empty or '-' get the number -1. `result` should be a table with the columns member_id and city_code, one row per member in file order.
intended_computation: Tidy home_city; the 8 known cities in alphabetical order get codes 0-7; empty and '-' cities get -1; return member_id and city_code for all 240 members in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: codes from any alphabetical collation of the accented city names are accepted (code-point or accent-insensitive/locale order)

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x converting to text makes the empty cells a city called 'Nan' that takes a code and shifts the later codes

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
